skillset.skill: 14s CT - 3000% Fire DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 20. For 10s, reduce enemies' Evasion rate by 20%.
skillset.arts: 20000% Fire DMG (PHY). For 25s, reduce enemies' ATK and CRI rate by 35%.
skillset.truearts: 100000% Fire DMG (PHY). For 40s, increase allies' PHY DMG by 100% (stackable). Additionally if unaffected by Status ailment(s), increase own Arts by 50.

passive.ability2: Increase own Arts by 4/s when above 80% HP.
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG by 50% against enemies under 30% HP.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Heroic Spirit Emiya's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Heroic Spirit Emiya's SP. Art is owned)
